name: two-repos-get-sub-issues
description: A feature that changes the API and the web app becomes one issue with two sub-issues, a contract between them, and a draft held for approval.
prompt: /plan-work plan Store owners can export their orders as CSV from the Orders page. The API repo `api` gets GET /orders/export returning text/csv with columns id, date, total. The web repo `web` adds an Export button on the Orders page that downloads the file. No flags. No tracker tool in this session: show the draft and stop. Do not run any tool except the bundled lint.

assertions.description: writes the contract between the parts
